generic_domain.justification: Selective Internal Radiation Therapy is a broader term that can encompass other types of radiation therapies, such as diffusing alpha-emitters radiation therapy. It refers to the targeted delivery of radioactive material directly into the bloodstream or specific body cavities, allowing for precise treatment of tumors while minimizing damage to healthy tissues. Diffusing Alpha-Emitter Radiation Therapy falls under this category as a specific method within selective internal radiation therapy. Therefore, Selective Internal Radiation Therapy is more comprehensive and generic than the other listed domains.
